title: urn:qauth:ia:password:v1-rc.0
description: The password factor. A rejected password, an unknown account and a disabled account give the same `invalid_credentials`, after the same timing floor (ADR-017 Decisions 3 and 4). Works without JavaScript: the form posts straight to the auth server with the step’s CSRF value (ADR-019 Decision 5).

password.description: The password. The server refuses one longer than 256 UTF-16 code units before anything else (ADR-017 Decision 8).

login_hint.description: The identifier: today an email address of at most 254 bytes in email syntax (ADR-017 Decision 3). The server normalises it before use. Sent only when the transaction holds no identifier yet: a page that asks for both at once.

personal.description: Who the transaction is for, so the screen can show it with a way to switch accounts. Absent until the transaction has an identifier.

identifier.description: The identifier of the account this transaction is for, as the person gave it or as the account holds it. Personal data: only the personal-data read returns it.

error.description: Why the last answer was refused. A closed set.

amr.description: The RFC 8176 `amr` values a successful answer adds to the transaction.
